channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Global funds eye Vietnam after stock market upgrade
item.description: Vietnam is drawing growing interest from major financial institutions and investment funds in developed markets such as the U.S., Europe, and Japan after its recent stock market upgrade, according to the State Securities Commission of Vietnam (SSC).

item.title: 11 foreign motorcyclists fined for riding on expressway in northern Vietnam
item.description: Vietnamese traffic police have fined a group of 11 foreign motorcyclists after they were found riding large-displacement motorcycles at high speed on Tuyen Quang - Phu Tho Expressway in northern Vietnam.

item.title: Alpine skiing-Helicopter crew recounts smooth but complex rescue after Vonn crash
item.description: CORTINA D'AMPEZZO, Italy - The helicopter crew tasked with evacuating U.S. ski great Lindsey Vonn from the Olimpia delle Tofane piste described a technically demanding but smoothly executed rescue operation carried out under bright skies during Sunday’s Olympic downhill.

item.title: Norwegian diplomat steps down over Epstein ties, in widening scandal
item.description: OSLO -- Norway's foreign ministry on Sunday said a prominent ambassador, Mona Juul, would step down due to a "serious failure of judgement" over ties to late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, part of a growing scandal in the Nordic country and across Europe.

item.title: Vietnam wins silver medal at Asian shooting championships
item.description: Vietnam won a silver medal in the men’s 25m standard pistol team event at the 2026 Asian Rifle and Pistol Championships in India on Sunday, the Vietnam Shooting Federation said.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City police bust armed cat-theft ring, recover stolen pets
item.description: Police in Ho Chi Minh City have dismantled a gang of cat thieves who used pepper spray to resist capture, recovering 18 stolen cats and arresting multiple suspects.

item.title: Indian couple chooses Da Nang for luxury wedding party
item.description: An Indian couple has recently hosted a lavish wedding in Da Nang City, central Vietnam, welcoming 250 guests at a luxury venue in the coastal city.

item.title: Vietnam reports multiple mistaken bank transfers returned, including nearly $200,500 case
item.description: In a series of notable cases in Vietnam over the past weeks, individuals and businesses who received large sums of money erroneously credited to their bank accounts have returned the funds to their rightful owners, underscoring legal obligations under Vietnamese law to give back mistakenly transferred money.

item.title: South Korean military helicopter crashes during training, killing 2
item.description: SEOUL -- A South Korean Army AH-1S Cobra attack helicopter crashed on Monday during a training flight in the northern county of Gapyeong, killing both crew members on board, the country's military said.

item.title: Asia stocks rally as Nikkei jumps, chip sector rebounds
item.description: SYDNEY -- Asian markets jumped on Monday as a resounding win for Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi whetted appetites for more reflationary policies, while there was widespread investor relief at a last-gasp rebound in U.S. chip stocks.
